title: Cebu governor warns against hog smuggling amid active ASF cases

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu Gov. Pamela Baricuatro has warned against the illegal entry of hogs into the province as authorities investigate the source of recently confirmed African Swine Fever (ASF) cases in Ginatilan town in southwestern Cebu. Baricuatro said the provincial government was still looking into how the virus reached two barangays in the southern Cebu town, where infections were confirmed this September. She said she discussed the situation with Negros Oriental Gov.
